description:
Anyone can walk away when it’s hard. The ones who win are the ones who stay long enough to change into the person who can handle it.

You quit? The future stays predictable.
You keep going? That’s when it gets interesting.
transcript: If you quit, it's really easy to predict your future. But if you don't quit, if you go for it with no proof, you can't quantify it. People are going to call you crazy. Your friends are going to look at you sideways. But you'll have the opportunity to play in the game and stop sitting on the sidelines. And you might fail for a while. But on the other side of that, you get to see who you're meant to be. Who God designed you to be. And tap into your full potential and there's nothing better.
